Reason for Mistake: The ImageProcessing_Expert made an error during the initial extraction of fractions using OCR. The extracted fractions included unsimplified forms (2/4, 5/35, 30/5). According to the task, the output should contain only simplified forms of the fractions—they should have been simplified during the extraction or a later step should have filtered them out from the result list. This oversight led to confusion regarding the proper output format, impacting the downstream processing by other experts.
